WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales, p.category, p.subcategory, 'sale' k
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net, p.category, p.subcategory, 'ret'
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(n.net_sales) garden_net, SUM(CASE WHEN n.subcategory='Outdoor Lighting' THEN n.net_sales END) outdoor_lighting,
 SUM(CASE WHEN k='sale' THEN n.net_sales END) sales_only, COUNT(*) n
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12 AND n.category='Garden'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
), mine AS (
 SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(net_sales) mine FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
 WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12 GROUP BY 1),
ctl AS (
 SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(net_sales) ctl FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
 WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12 AND r.store_id<>999 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT m.fiscal_period, m.mine, c.ctl, m.mine-c.ctl diff FROM mine m JOIN ctl c USING (fiscal_period) ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'prod_version_mismatch' k, COUNT(*) v FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-04-27' AND NOT (f.sale_date BETWEEN p.valid_from AND p.valid_to)
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_lines_no_dispatch', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
 WHERE s.store_id=900 AND (o.web_order_id IS NULL OR o.dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL OR o.status NOT IN ('delivered','collected'))
UNION ALL SELECT 'garden_lines_in_store999', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.store_id=999 AND p.category='Garden'
UNION ALL SELECT 'returns_orphan', COUNT(*) FROM fact_return_line r LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id WHERE f.sales_line_id IS NULL
